labels.name: Anterior cruciate ligament
labels.function: Resists forward tibial translation; Lachman is most sensitive

labels.name: Posterior cruciate ligament
labels.function: Resists backward tibial translation; dashboard injury

labels.name: Medial collateral ligament
labels.function: Resists valgus stress; hurt by a blow to the outer knee

labels.name: Lateral collateral ligament
labels.function: Resists varus stress; hurt by force toward the inner knee

labels.name: Medial meniscus
labels.function: Torn cushion found by McMurray with external tibial rotation

labels.name: Lateral meniscus
labels.function: Torn cushion found by McMurray with internal tibial rotation

labels.name: Anterior talofibular ligament
labels.function: Weakest lateral ligament; torn first by excessive inversion

labels.name: Deltoid ligament
accept: medial collateral ligament of the ankle
labels.function: Strong medial fan resisting eversion; sprain often with fracture

labels.name: Anterior inferior tibiofibular ligament
labels.function: Most often torn part of the syndesmosis in a high ankle sprain

labels.name: Lateral malleolus
labels.function: Fibular end forming the outer wall of the ankle socket

labels.name: Medial malleolus
labels.function: Tibial projection that anchors the strong eversion-resisting fan

labels.name: Talus
labels.function: Bone seated in the socket formed by the tibia and fibula

labels.name: Anterior compartment
labels.function: Dorsiflexors and toe extensors; denervation gives foot drop

labels.name: Lateral compartment
labels.function: Evertors of the foot

labels.name: Posterior compartment
labels.function: Plantarflexion, toe flexion and inversion

labels.name: Deep fibular nerve
labels.function: Cut alone: foot drop, eversion kept, first web space numb

labels.name: Superficial fibular nerve
labels.function: Injury: weak eversion and a numb dorsum of the foot

labels.name: Tibial nerve
labels.function: Supplies the sole; compressed in the tarsal tunnel

labels.name: Saphenous nerve
labels.function: Purely sensory to medial leg and foot; femoral nerve branch

labels.name: Sural nerve
labels.function: Purely sensory to the lateral foot; harvested for grafts
